name: Charlotte Pudding
title:
The overwhelming might of the Charlotte Family!

This purple/yellow deck solidly covers both DON!! and Life.
desc: A Charlotte Pudding deck mixing purple's DON!! acceleration with yellow's powerful {Big Mom Pirates} type cards. If you can play the high-cost Charlotte Linlin a turn earlier than normal, you'll dominate in Life and field presence.

cards.name: Charlotte Pudding
cards.text: [When Attacking] You may turn 2 cards from the top of your Life cards face-up: Add up to 1 DON!! card from your DON!! deck and rest it.

cards.name: Charlotte Flampe
cards.text: [On Play] You may add 1 card from the top or bottom of your Life cards to your hand: Draw 1 card.

cards.name: Charlotte Pudding
cards.text: [On Play] Look at 4 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 [Sanji] or {Big Mom Pirates} type card other than [Charlotte Pudding] and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.

cards.name: Streusen
cards.text: [On Play] You may trash 1 card with a [Trigger] from your hand: K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 1 or less.

cards.name: Viola
cards.text:
[Blocker] (After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.)
[On Play] Choose one:
• Look at all of your opponent's Life cards and place them back in their Life area in any order.
• Turn all of your Life cards face-down.

cards.name: Shirahoshi
cards.text:
When this Character is K.O.'d by your opponent's effect, add up to 1 card from the top of your deck to the top of your Life cards.
[Blocker] (After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.)

cards.name: Charlotte Perospero
cards.text: [On K.O.] Look at 3 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 {Big Mom Pirates} type card and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
cards.trigger: [Trigger] You may trash 1 card from your hand: Play this card.

cards.name: Charlotte Brulee
cards.text: [Blocker] (After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.)

cards.name: Sanji
cards.text:
If the number of DON!! cards on your field is at least 2 less than the number on your opponent's field, give this card in your hand −3 cost.
[Blocker] (After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.)

cards.name: Charlotte Katakuri
cards.text: [On Play] You may turn 1 card from the top of your Life cards face-down: Add up to 1 DON!! card from your DON!! deck and set it as active.

cards.name: Charlotte Linlin
cards.text:
[On Play] Your opponent chooses one:
- Trash 1 card from the top of your opponent's Life cards.
- Add 1 card from the top of your deck to the top of your Life cards.

cards.name: Charlotte Katakuri
cards.text: [On Play] Add up to 1 Character with a cost of 8 or less to the top or bottom of the owner's Life cards face-up.

cards.name: Charlotte Linlin
cards.text: [On Play] DON!! −1, You may trash 1 card from your hand: Add up to 1 card from the top of your deck to the top of your Life cards. Then, add up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 6 or less to the top or bottom of your opponent's Life cards face-up.

cards.name: Charlotte Linlin
cards.text: [On Play] If your Leader has the {Big Mom Pirates} type, add up to 1 card from the top of your deck to the top of your Life cards. Then, trash up to 1 card from the top of your opponent's Life cards.

cards.name: We're Going to Claim the One Piece!!!
cards.name_en: We're Going to Claim the One Piece!!!
cards.text: [Main] If your Leader has the {Animal Kingdom Pirates} or {Big Mom Pirates} type, look at 5 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 {Animal Kingdom Pirates} or {Big Mom Pirates} type card and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.

cards.name: Conquest of the Sea
cards.types: The Four Emperors/Animal Kingdom Pirates/Big Mom Pirates
cards.text: [Main] DON!! −2 (You may return the specified number of DON!! cards from your field to your DON!! deck.): If your Leader has the {Animal Kingdom Pirates} or {Big Mom Pirates} type, K.O. up to 2 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 6 or less.
